sites.w: Binhai New Area, Tianjin Port, Tianjin, CHN
sites.cs: State Council investigation report (Feb 2016): N39 02'22.98" E117 44'11.64"
f: fire then explosions in a hazardous-goods yard
nitrocellulose (self-ignited), ammonium nitrate (~800 t exploded), sodium cyanide and other hazardous goods
Tianjin Dongjiang Port Ruihai International Logistics Co.

304 buildings, 12,428 vehicles and 7,533 containers damaged; direct economic loss 6.866 billion yuan. About 3% of the used sodium cyanide remained in soil after clean-up; no deaths attributed to pollution.

sites.n: AZF (Grande Paroisse) fertilizer plant explosion, Toulouse
f: ammonium nitrate off-spec rejects, 20-120 t in hangar 221 (20-40 t TNT equivalent estimated)
31 (21 on site, 1 at the neighbouring plant, 9 outside)
Crater about 65 x 45 x 7 m; widespread damage across Toulouse. 2006 court experts: mixing of sodium dichloroisocyanurate (DCCNa) with ammonium nitrate as cause.
